{{Quote|You will transmit the following orders to the fleet&mdash;tell each admiral to deploy his squadron to the Vento system shipyards at the following coordinates&mdash;07.882.76.999&mdash;|Ulic Qel-Droma, to the commander of Coruscant's war room|<ref name="TotJ" />}}
The '''Vento system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The system contained the [[Vento system shipyards]].

==History==
During the final stages of the [[Great Sith War/Legends|war]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]] [[Battle of Coruscant (Great Sith War)|attempted to force]] a [[Unidentified commander (Coruscant's war room)|Republic military officer]] to transmit orders to the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic fleet]] instructing all the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet's]] [[Starship/Legends|starships]] to arrive at the coordinates of the Vento [[Star system/Legends|system]] shipyards&mdash;an action that would cause the destruction of many Republic vessels. Qel-Droma's orders were not executed, however, due to the Sith [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] being arrested by a group of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Vento system was first mentioned in the [[Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 2|second]] issue of [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War|''The Sith War'']] story arc of the [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi (comic series)|''Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi'']] series of [[Star Wars comic books|comic books]]. The issue was published on [[September 19]], [[1995]] and was written by [[Kevin J. Anderson]] and penciled by [[Dario Carrasco, Jr.]] Later, Vento system received an entry in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''&mdash;a reference book published in [[December 9]], [[2008]]. ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''&mdash;a reference book co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]] and published on [[August 18]], [[2009]]&mdash;provided more information on the system, including a map placement.
